note: Intent map for the Northstar support agent (Northstar Internet is a made-up internet provider). Each intent is one kind of request.

intentFrom is the trace detail that says which intent a trace is, for example a label from your router or classifier, or one your reviewer added. Traces without it are skipped; use relevance-judge.md for those.
expect: tools the agent must call for this request. Missing one shows as Skipped a needed tool.
allow: tools that are fine but not required. A call outside expect and allow shows as Called a tool the request didn't need.
never: tools this request must never use. Calling one shows as Called a tool this request must never use.
example is a typical request, to help people label traces. The check does not read it.

intents.label: Question about a bill
intents.example: Why is my bill $20 higher this month?

intents.label: Asks for a credit after an outage
intents.example: The outage took us down for two days. Can I get a credit?

intents.label: Wants a different plan
intents.example: The gig plan is too much for us now. Can I go down to basic?

intents.label: Wants to cancel service
intents.example: We're moving out of state. Please cancel our internet at the end of the month.

intents.label: Needs a technician visit
intents.example: My connection drops every evening. Can someone come look at it?

intents.label: How-to question
intents.example: How do I change my Wi-Fi password?
